snippet.title: Exterminauts | Reveal Trailer | gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
We’re hiring. Punch in for the next shift—and a brand-new line of work.

Exterminauts is a three-player co-op third-person shooter where blue-collar crews take the contracts no one else will touch. Head into the hottest zones on Planet Tian, keep the worksite running, and turn industrial tools into Pest-control weapons. Work together, fight through a living alien ecosystem, and stay on the job until it's time for your crew to be extracted.

The toughest crew on the contract.
The last ones to leave the worksite.
Getting paid to do what others won’t.

Punch in. Clean up. Get paid.
